rna_snapshot.source_description: Local TCGA cohort directories with count_matrix.tsv, col_data.tsv, clinical_data.tsv and dds.rds generated by the local download pipeline.

submission_note: For final journal submission, run this script with --hash-count-matrices. If the RNA snapshot was created by the application updater, include the GDC sync manifest with --rna-sync-manifest. Archive this manifest with the software release.
